assumptions: Only supplied positive answer witnesses are checked against the selected query and active fact snapshot.
The verifier does not rerun query evaluation or search for additional answers.
A finite known-reference domain and a producer Complete flag do not prove answer-set completeness.
Conflicting negative records are reported as evidence conflict and do not erase positive support.

diagnostics.message: plan and active evidence fingerprints must match the actual selected inputs

validation_scope: independent checking of supplied positive answer witnesses against the compiled query and active fact snapshot; completeness is never verified
